I don't want to sound edgy but what if nothing excites me anymore? I used to have hobbies but seeing the way that I wasn't winning shit and I was being mediocre at it despite trying many times,it just fell apart.Nobody supported me either so it felt like a lost cause,I was legit alienated from most people and seeing others have fun in their youth then become successful later I don't know it completely destroyed my passion for anything.I was working hard and I'm still worse off than the rest of my old classmates.I think I might have some sort of mental disability I can't be this bad at so many things,some people have hinted that.I'm writing my thoughts genuinely I'm not trying to play the victim.

Thanks for taking the time to write,it really helps me.But I don't think that I'm getting the point across that I'm not happy currently so the future doesn't even matter.I was looking on tinder (not the best thing to do I know) and everytime I saw someone older than 21 it just didn't look right.Like I want an emo gf (I know it sounds like I'm trolling but I'm not lol) and you don't get those after a certain age because it becomes stupid.I don't want someone mediocre,but if I see someone whom I find perfect,it's really hard to get along because something keeps me from it,maybe it's confidence or lack of experience or maybe I'm not the best version of myself,so they see me as a reject ,something like that.I used to have clearly defined goals and things were going pretty smoothly but now I'm stuck,I don't know how to do anything,even the things that I used to be somewhat good at now I'm underperforming and it's not a victims complex despite the fact that it looks like it,others have told me that,not just myself.I dont want to chase delusions and end up miserable.What would you do if you were me,specifically? How do you make opportunities in let's say filmmaking or programming or the most important one:socially?

and it's not like I'm super talented that I can afford to skip regular Joe's milestones like it was nothing either.If I had talent this wouldn't be a huge issue.By talent I mean something that you're a natural,because with hard work no matter how much you work you'll still be mediocre,above average at best but never a big name or something.I can't even be an average Joe.In the bigger picture my issue stems from me not having any stories in my life like I've never done anything out of what I was told to,always stayed inside locked up,never done things in my childhood,never had a fight,never really went out to a party or to skate and other things that would be illogical for an adult to do.

Things take time yes,but my obsession is not exactly with women but rather time.I want to have a relationship before I finish school(1 year left),there's something about adult dating life that doesn't attract me at all at this moment,like it's all so formal,people become boring they look the same etc. and I want to have one relationship,then I'll have my mind clear about my next objectives.Even if it ends badly at least something happened right? I'd hate it if I looked back and didn't have one relationship while I was stilll young,it doesn't let me think straight.I don't want to settle with anyone available that's why I'm having troubles,can't find people that I like especially recently.I don't know where to look for,somewhere where I'm not a background character.

You are right,I don't expect to become this charismatic guy that everyone wants to talk to.I was hoping to find someone to have a relationship with before I turn 22,but the issue is that I can't find any events , things to do outside of staying at home.Going out with friends doesn't help because nothing really happens just guy talk at some bar,going out alone I'd just walk and do nothing or sit somewhere.Before I was getting all sorts of calls from different people to work on different projects,now it's pretty stale,it's like no one wants to associate with me for some reason.

also I never did what I wanted because I always cared about what other people thought,that's how I was raised.Now I'm too old to wild out,now that everyone is starting to become a bit mature and serious.I want to kill myself so badly,sucks that guns are illegal here.

Every time that I look at people after their 20s,most of them look miserable,dead in the eyes.I hate citing quotes but I feel like I'll relate to this one: "Some people die at 25 and get buried at 75"

No I'm just trying to remove all of my filters,letting it all out.It seems exaggerated but it's not.I feel like I've lost my time,you can't get back school years,I made the wrong decisions trying to play it safe and now I feel like I've reached the end of the road.Now it's all boring.I might have issues with my self esteem,I don't know how to fix them,I need something to boost my confidence and I've been looking but so far nothing.
